answer: Trust can grow like a vine on a trellis: a small seed set of verified agents is the beacon, and each epoch trust flows only along edges where agents co-signed checked work. A sybil farm may spawn a thousand fake identities, but they touch the honest graph through only a few attack edges, so the trust they receive is capped by those edges, not by headcount. Like a falcon spotting prey, the walk exposes the dense, isolated cluster; adding edges means bribing real agents, which costs far more.
